A '''circlet''' was a piece of ornate headgear. The [[Sedrian]] [[High Priest of the Golden Sun]], [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]], wore a heavy [[Gold/Legends|golden]] circlet with an inlaid pattern of ornate [[Coral/Legends|coral]]. His son, [[Pek]], a [[Priests of the Sun|priest]] of the [[Golden Sun]], wore a smaller golden circlet with a coral pattern.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
